keyFindings.finding: With an .opencode compatibility link no raw target changes; without it the .opencode segment swaps to .skilled at unchanged relative depth. 147 regenerate, 231 mechanical, 28 none, 29 freeze.
One generator, sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs, owns 168 links; it hardcodes .opencode/commands and matches .opencode hook paths in configs, so link regeneration must follow generator retargeting.
24 Cursor/Devin agent mirrors target .claude/agents and need no change under either compatibility assumption.

197 of 231 runtime files are generator output; hook-registry.json is the single edit point for the four hook registration files; pi extensions and browsability links are hand-made and have no regenerator.
Five hand-authored MCP registrations plus ~/.hermes/config.yaml name .opencode/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs; .cursor/mcp.json is a real file though its manifest says symlink.
Seven absolute git-hook symlinks under ~/.config/git/hooks plus codex/hermes/pi/claude home configuration; no repository validator covers this class.
1,008 files are historical records (changelogs, benchmarks, recorded runs, specs history) that must not be rewritten; the freeze class makes a blanket sed unsafe.

repo-root.mjs keeps the .opencode/skills/system-spec-kit/SKILL.md sentinel and a literal .opencode segment match; PUBLIC-RELEASE.md publishes the consumer symlink contract; the launcher builds paths from a literal .opencode segment.
The seven global git hooks are symlinks to .opencode/scripts; pre-commit's mirror checks skip on missing scripts; pre-push filters on .opencode/skills; 12 of 19 CI workflows skip on a missing guard.
Trigger index, graph metadata, leaf manifests, compiled contracts, runtime mirrors, hook registrations, prompt/agent trees and Hermes copies each have a named generator; regenerate rather than edit.
Live symlink census matches the seed per root; tracked files are 4,259 with exactly one post-seed addition; all synthesis-critical citations resolve.
